class.name: PlayGames
class.description: Signs the player in to Play Games, reports achievements and leaderboard scores, and lists the player's friends. It can also keep files in the player's Play Games saved games. Most games use [Purr], which uses this on Android; it's here for anything [Purr] doesn't cover. It's off unless [code]play_games/app_id[/code] in Project Settings is the game's application ID from the Play Console. Export with the Android preset's Gradle Build > Use Gradle Build on; Purr adds Play Games to the build. For Purr's online services, set [code]play_games/server_client_id[/code] to the OAuth web client ID the service uses. For saves in Play Games, turn on saved games for the game in the Play Console and [code]play_games/saved_games[/code] in Project Settings. Each asynchronous call returns a signal that fires once with a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and, when it failed, [code]error[/code]. [codeblock] var signed_in = await PlayGames.authenticate() if signed_in.ok: PlayGames.unlock_achievement("CgkI...") [/codeblock]

method.name: authenticate
method.description: Signs the player in to Play Games. Play Games usually signs players in by itself when the game starts; if it hasn't and [param interactive] is [code]true[/code], Google's sign-in screen shows. Await it: the result has [code]player_id[/code] and [code]player_name[/code] when it succeeds.

method.name: delete_file
method.description: Deletes a file from the player's saved games. Await it for [code]ok[/code].

method.name: get_player_id
method.description: The signed-in player's Play Games ID, or an empty string.

method.name: get_player_name
method.description: The signed-in player's Play Games name, or an empty string.

method.name: increment_achievement
method.description: Adds [param steps] to an incremental achievement. Play Games sends it when it can.

method.name: is_authenticated
method.description: Whether a player is signed in.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Whether Play Games is in this game: on Android, exported with it, with [code]play_games/app_id[/code] set.

method.name: is_saved_games_enabled
method.description: Whether the file calls work: a player is signed in and [code]play_games/saved_games[/code] is on.

method.name: list_files
method.description: Lists the files in the player's saved games. Await it: the result's [code]files[/code] is an [Array] of [Dictionary], each with [code]name[/code], [code]modified[/code] (milliseconds since 1970) and [code]metadata[/code].

method.name: get_achievements
method.description: Loads the player's achievements. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]achievements[/code], [code]{id: {"unlocked", "current_steps", "total_steps"}}[/code], the steps [code]0[/code] for achievements that aren't incremental.

method.name: load_file
method.description: Reads a file from the player's saved games. Await it: the result has [code]data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]modified[/code] and [code]metadata[/code].

method.name: load_friends
method.description: The player's Play Games friends. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]friends[/code], an [Array] of [Dictionary] with [code]id[/code] (their player ID) and [code]name[/code]. The first time, Play Games asks the player whether to share their friends with the game, and the result comes once they've answered ([code]error[/code] [code]"cancelled"[/code] if they said no). Purr's [method Friends.get_all] calls it.

method.name: get_scores
method.description: Loads up to [param count] all-time scores (25 at most), as [param scope] says. Await it: the result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code] and [code]scores[/code], each with [code]rank[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]score[/code] and [code]player[/code].

method.name: request_server_auth_code
method.description: Asks Google for a one-time code a server exchanges to confirm who the player is, for the OAuth client in [code]play_games/server_client_id[/code]. Await it: the result has [code]code[/code], what [method PurrOnline.sign_in_play_games] takes.

method.name: save_file
method.description: Writes a file to the player's saved games, replacing one with the same name, with [param metadata] kept beside it. When two devices write the same file, Play Games keeps the newest. Await it: the result has [code]modified[/code].

method.name: set_achievement_steps
method.description: Sets an incremental achievement's steps, unlocking it at its total. Play Games never lowers them.

method.name: show_achievements
method.description: Shows Play Games' list of the game's achievements.

method.name: show_leaderboard
method.description: Shows a leaderboard, or all of the game's leaderboards when [param leaderboard_id] is empty.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits a score to a leaderboard. Play Games sends it when it can.

method.name: unlock_achievement
method.description: Unlocks an achievement. Play Games sends it when it can.

constants.constant: The best among the player's friends.
Those around the player's own, or the best if they have none.
